name: FP16 SegFormer + matched retrained regressor
purpose: Train and evaluate an experiment-local waviness regressor using the exact final 224x224 images produced by the fast-v2.1 FP16 SegFormer path.

pipeline.segmentation_runtime: ONNX Runtime MIGraphX Execution Provider with migraphx_fp16_enable=1
pipeline.preprocessing: Decode and orient HEIC; OpenCV INTER_AREA resize to 448x448; ImageNet normalize; FP16 MIGraphX SegFormer water mask; nearest-exact projection to 224x224; lower-water crop selection; map crop to original-source coordinates; Lanczos4 resize and apply mask on 224x224 black canvas; JPEG quality 95 with 4:4:4 subsampling; decode JPEG to RGB for the regressor.
pipeline.regressor_training_input: Exact final 224x224 RGB JPEG bytes emitted by the FP16 inference path; standard deterministic ImageNet normalization at training and evaluation time.
pipeline.regressor_backbone: EfficientNet-B0 ImageNet pretrained, frozen feature extractor, trained sigmoid regression head

dataset.test_policy: Prepare/evaluate test only after the best checkpoint has been selected on validation.

training.augmentations: Random horizontal flip p=0.5; ColorJitter brightness=0.25, contrast=0.25, saturation=0.20, hue=0.02.

comparison.baseline: Current fast-v2.1 FP32 SegFormer + current ONNX regressor
comparison.candidate: FP16 SegFormer + this experiment's validation-selected regressor
comparison.speed_measurement: Raw photo to waviness score; one warm-up and three measured runs per held-out test photo; model startup reported separately.

artifacts_policy: Generated masked training inputs, checkpoints, and ONNX model stay in the experiment-local ignored artifacts directory. Reports and hashes are retained in the repository.
